name: Acoustic
description: Music centered on the sound of acoustic instruments and voices, often with sparse arrangements that foreground the performance.

name: Afro house
description: House music built around layered African percussion, syncopated grooves, and melodic or vocal elements from African dance traditions.

name: Afro-Cuban jazz
description: Jazz improvisation and harmony combined with Afro-Cuban rhythmic patterns such as clave and instruments such as congas and timbales.

name: Afrobeats
description: Contemporary West African popular music, especially from Nigeria and Ghana, built around syncopated dance rhythms, melodic vocals, and influences from local and global styles.

name: Alternative rock
description: Rock rooted in independent and underground scenes, often combining guitar-driven arrangements with unconventional textures or songwriting.

name: Amapiano
description: South African dance music recognized by its deep log-drum bass, syncopated percussion, and spacious piano or keyboard chords.

name: Ambient
description: Music that foregrounds atmosphere, texture, and space, often using slowly evolving sounds and a subtle or absent beat.

name: Arabic classical
description: Art music traditions of the Arab world built around maqam, rhythmic cycles, and expressive vocal or instrumental performance.

name: Arabic hip-hop
description: Hip-hop performed primarily in Arabic, using rap and beat production alongside regional dialects, samples, or musical influences.

name: Arabic pop
description: Arabic-language popular music that combines regional melodies, rhythms, and vocal phrasing with contemporary pop production.

name: Bachata
description: Dominican dance music with interlocking guitar lines, bongo and güira rhythms, and often romantic vocals.

name: Bebop
description: A small-group jazz style marked by fast tempos, complex chord changes, and agile improvisation.

name: Bhangra
description: Punjabi music rooted in dance traditions, driven by dhol rhythms and often produced with contemporary pop or electronic sounds.

name: Bluegrass
description: Acoustic American roots music featuring instruments such as banjo, fiddle, and mandolin, with close vocal harmonies and instrumental breaks.

name: Blues
description: An African American music tradition characterized by expressive phrasing, blue notes, and recurring forms such as the twelve-bar blues.

name: Blues rock
description: Rock that builds on blues riffs, phrasing, and forms, typically with amplified guitar and a strong backbeat.

name: Bollywood
description: Popular music from Hindi cinema, spanning film songs that blend South Asian musical traditions with pop, dance, and other global styles.

name: Boom bap
description: A hip-hop production style built around punchy kick and snare patterns, sample-based loops, and prominent rap vocals.

name: Bossa nova
description: Brazilian music combining a soft samba-derived guitar rhythm with understated vocals and jazz-influenced harmony.

name: Breakbeat
description: Electronic dance music organized around syncopated drum breaks, often sampled or programmed into repeating patterns.

name: Chamber music
description: Classical music for a small ensemble, typically with one performer per part and close interaction among the players.

name: Chillout
description: Relaxed, often electronic music with soft textures and gentle rhythms, suited to low-energy listening and lounge settings.

name: Christian music
description: Music centered on Christian faith, worship, or devotional themes across styles such as pop, rock, hymns, and gospel.

name: Classic rock
description: A catalog and radio category for enduring rock recordings, especially from the late 1960s through the 1980s.

name: Classical
description: Western art music spanning historical and contemporary traditions, including works for soloists, chamber ensembles, orchestras, and voices.

name: Contemporary R&B
description: A modern vocal-led style blending R&B and soul with pop, hip-hop, and electronic production.

name: Country
description: American popular music rooted in rural folk traditions, often combining storytelling lyrics with guitar, fiddle, banjo, or steel guitar.

name: Cumbia
description: A dance music tradition originating in Colombia, recognized by its lilting rhythm and developed into many regional Latin American styles.

name: Dabke
description: Music for a Levantine group dance, with a strong pulse that supports synchronized steps and stomps.

name: Dance pop
description: Pop songwriting with catchy hooks, a steady dance beat, and polished production designed for both radio and the dance floor.

name: Dancehall
description: Jamaican popular music built around rhythmic vocal delivery over repeated riddims, often using digital production.

name: Deep house
description: House with warm bass, restrained grooves, and rich chords influenced by soul and jazz.

name: Dembow
description: A Dominican dance style built around a fast, repeating rhythm, sparse production, and energetic vocal chants.

name: Disco
description: Dance music with a steady four-on-the-floor beat, syncopated bass, and often strings, horns, or lush vocal arrangements.

name: Disco house
description: House music that uses disco samples or live-sounding disco basslines, strings, and vocals over a steady club beat.

name: Downtempo
description: Beat-driven music with a slower pace, often using electronic production, sampling, and atmospheric textures.

name: Drill
description: A hip-hop style originating in Chicago, typically using dark loops, sparse beats, and forceful rap delivery, with distinct regional variants.

name: Drum and bass
description: Fast electronic dance music built around rapid syncopated breakbeats and heavy basslines.

name: Dub
description: A Jamaican production tradition that reshapes recordings by emphasizing bass, drums, echo, reverb, and strategic drops in the mix.

name: Dubstep
description: Electronic dance music that originated in the UK, typically using syncopated half-time rhythms and deep sub-bass.

name: EDM
description: An umbrella label for electronically produced dance music, often applied to club and festival styles such as house, trance, and dubstep.

name: Egyptian pop
description: Popular music from Egypt, typically sung in Egyptian Arabic and blending local vocal and melodic traditions with modern pop production.

name: Electro house
description: House music with a prominent four-on-the-floor beat, punchy synthesized bass, and bright or distorted electronic leads.

name: Electronica
description: A broad label for music made primarily with electronic instruments and production, spanning experimental, atmospheric, and beat-driven styles.

name: Electropop
description: Pop songs in which synthesizers and electronic production shape the arrangement, with vocals and hooks at the center.

name: Film score
description: Music composed for a film to support its scenes, pacing, characters, and emotional development.

name: Flamenco
description: An Andalusian performance tradition combining expressive singing, guitar, dance, and rhythmic handclaps across distinct forms.

name: Folk
description: Music rooted in community traditions, including songs transmitted across generations and contemporary works drawing on those traditions.

name: Funk
description: Groove-centered music built around syncopated bass, tight drums, and interlocking guitar, keyboard, or horn parts.

name: Gospel
description: Christian vocal music rooted in Black American church traditions, often featuring powerful lead singing, choirs, and call-and-response.

name: Hard rock
description: A guitar-driven rock style with loud, distorted riffs, forceful drumming, and prominent vocals.

name: Hardstyle
description: Electronic dance music with hard distorted kicks, a fast regular pulse, and often dramatic melodic breaks.

name: Heavy metal
description: A foundational metal style centered on powerful distorted riffs, driving drums, and often dramatic vocals and guitar solos.

name: Highlife
description: A West African popular music tradition, strongly associated with Ghana, featuring lilting rhythms, interlocking guitars, or dance-band horns.

name: Hip-hop
description: A musical tradition built around rhythmic vocal delivery, beatmaking, sampling, and DJ techniques, with many regional and stylistic forms.

name: House
description: Electronic dance music originating in Chicago, built around a four-on-the-floor kick, repeating bass patterns, and grooves designed for continuous mixing.

name: Indie pop
description: Pop rooted in independent music scenes, often pairing melodic hooks with intimate vocals or understated production.

name: Indie rock
description: Rock rooted in independent music scenes, often using guitar-led arrangements with a wide range of experimental or intimate approaches.

name: J-pop
description: Japanese popular music encompassing melodic, hook-driven styles associated with solo artists, bands, idol groups, and media soundtracks.

name: Jazz
description: An African American music tradition with a wide range of styles, often emphasizing improvisation, rhythmic interplay, and expressive phrasing.

name: Jungle
description: A UK dance style built around fast chopped breakbeats, heavy sub-bass, and frequent reggae or sound-system influences.

name: K-pop
description: South Korean popular music spanning dance-pop, hip-hop, R&B, and other styles, often associated with idol groups and polished vocal production.

name: Khaliji
description: Music of the Arab Gulf, often featuring Gulf Arabic vocals over layered percussion and regional rhythms such as samri.

name: Latin jazz
description: Jazz improvisation and harmony combined with rhythms and performance traditions from Latin America and the Caribbean.

name: Latin pop
description: Popular music rooted in Latin American and Spanish-speaking markets, blending pop songwriting with a wide range of regional rhythms and styles.

name: Lebanese pop
description: Popular music from Lebanon that often pairs Lebanese Arabic vocals and regional melodies with contemporary pop and dance production.

name: Levantine folk
description: Traditional music of the Levant, encompassing regional songs, dance tunes, and oral poetry performed in local styles and dialects.

name: Lounge
description: Music suited to relaxed social settings, often using mellow jazz, downtempo beats, or soft instrumental arrangements.

name: Mahraganat
description: Egyptian electronic street music from Cairo’s wedding scene, built around programmed beats, synthesizers, and heavily processed vocals.

name: Mambo
description: A Cuban dance music style with syncopated percussion, interlocking ensemble parts, and emphatic brass riffs in big-band arrangements.

name: Mawwal
description: An Arabic vocal form in which a singer elaborates on a vernacular poem, often using improvised ornamentation and flexible rhythm.

name: Melodic house
description: House music that foregrounds memorable synth melodies, warm harmonies, and gradual development over a steady dance beat.

name: Melodic techno
description: Techno that pairs a steady, driving beat with recurring synthesizer motifs, layered harmonies, and atmospheric builds.

name: Merengue
description: Dominican dance music with a brisk, even pulse and a characteristic rhythmic interplay between tambora and güira.

name: Metal
description: A family of rock-derived styles centered on heavily distorted riffs, prominent drums, and a range of vocal and rhythmic approaches.

name: Minimal techno
description: Techno that creates movement through sparse arrangements, repeated patterns, small changes in texture, and precise percussion.

name: Neo-soul
description: A contemporary soul style that blends expressive vocals and rich harmonies with influences from R&B, jazz, funk, and hip-hop.

name: Nu-disco
description: A contemporary revival of disco and boogie sounds, combining funky basslines and vintage textures with modern dance production.

name: Opera
description: A staged dramatic work told through singing and instrumental music, often combining soloists, chorus, and orchestra.

name: Orchestral
description: Music arranged for an orchestra, typically using strings, woodwinds, brass, and percussion in varied combinations.

name: Organic house
description: House with earthy textures, acoustic instrumentation or samples, layered percussion, and a gentle, steady club groove.

name: Persian pop
description: Popular music sung mainly in Persian, blending local melodic or vocal traditions with contemporary pop arrangements and production.

name: Pop
description: Popular music centered on memorable melodies, accessible song structures, and recurring hooks, drawing on a wide variety of styles.

name: Progressive house
description: House built around gradually evolving arrangements, layered melodies, and extended builds over a steady dance beat.

name: Progressive trance
description: Trance that develops through gradual changes in texture, melody, and energy over a steady pulse and repeating bassline.

name: Psytrance
description: Fast electronic dance music with a rolling bassline, repeated rhythmic patterns, and psychedelic synthetic textures.

name: Punk rock
description: Direct, energetic rock typically built around short songs, fast tempos, simple chord progressions, and raw vocal delivery.

name: Qawwali
description: South Asian Sufi devotional music featuring lead and chorus singing, rhythmic handclaps, and accompaniment such as harmonium and tabla.

name: R&B
description: A broad family of African American popular music that developed from blues, jazz, and gospel and includes both classic rhythm and blues and modern vocal-led styles.

name: Rai
description: Algerian popular music associated with Oran, combining regional song traditions with modern arrangements and candid lyrics about everyday life.

name: Rap
description: Music centered on spoken or chanted rhymes delivered rhythmically, usually over a produced beat.

name: Reggae
description: Jamaican music known for offbeat accents, prominent basslines, and relaxed but tightly coordinated rhythmic grooves.

name: Reggaeton
description: A Caribbean-rooted urban dance style driven by the dembow rhythm and featuring rhythmic singing or rap, often in Spanish.

name: Rock
description: A broad tradition of popular music commonly built around electric guitar, bass, drums, and a strong backbeat.

name: Salsa
description: Latin dance music drawing heavily on Afro-Cuban traditions, with clave-based rhythms, layered percussion, and often brass and call-and-response vocals.

name: Samba
description: A family of Afro-Brazilian music and dance styles characterized by syncopated rhythms and layered percussion.

name: Shaabi
description: Egyptian urban popular music associated with working-class Cairo, often featuring colloquial lyrics and rhythms suited to social dancing.

name: Singer-songwriter
description: Music that foregrounds an artist’s own songs, often using intimate vocals and lyrics with acoustic or relatively sparse accompaniment.

name: Ska
description: A Jamaican style with brisk offbeat guitar or piano accents, a moving bassline, and often horns, with later revivals around the world.

name: Smooth jazz
description: A polished jazz-derived style combining melodic saxophone or guitar with accessible grooves influenced by pop and R&B.

name: Soul
description: African American popular music combining gospel-derived vocal expression with the rhythms and arrangements of rhythm and blues.

name: Soulful house
description: House with warm chords and expressive vocals that draw on soul, gospel, and R&B over a steady dance beat.

name: Soundtrack
description: Music associated with a film, series, game, or other production, which can include original score, commissioned songs, and existing recordings.

name: Swing
description: A jazz style built for dancing, often associated with big bands, arranged horn sections, and a buoyant rhythmic feel.

name: Synth-pop
description: Pop music built around synthesizers and electronic rhythms, typically using structured songs, melodic hooks, and prominent vocals.

name: Tango
description: A music and dance tradition from the Río de la Plata, known for expressive phrasing, rhythmic accents, and often the bandoneon.

name: Tarab
description: An Arabic performance tradition and the musical rapture it evokes through expressive singing, improvisation, and interaction with listeners.

name: Tech house
description: A club style combining the swing and groove of house with the stripped-down percussion and textures of techno.

name: Techno
description: Electronic dance music rooted in Detroit, driven by repeating machine rhythms, synthesized textures, and gradual variation.

name: Trance
description: Electronic dance music with a steady pulse, repeating melodic patterns, and extended builds and breakdowns designed to create a sense of lift.

name: Trap
description: A Southern US hip-hop style recognizable by deep 808 bass, rapid hi-hat rolls, and sparse beats, with related electronic dance variants.

name: Trip-hop
description: Downtempo music associated with Bristol that combines hip-hop-derived beats, samples, and atmospheric production.

name: Turkish folk
description: Traditional music from across Türkiye, reflecting regional song and dance forms and often featuring instruments such as the bağlama.

name: Turkish pop
description: Popular music sung mainly in Turkish, blending contemporary pop production with a range of local melodic, vocal, and rhythmic influences.

name: UK bass
description: An umbrella label for British club music centered on sub-bass and syncopated rhythms, drawing on styles such as garage, dubstep, and jungle.

name: UK garage
description: British dance music with swung or two-step rhythms, prominent basslines, and often chopped or soulful vocals.

name: World fusion
description: Music that blends identifiable elements from multiple regional traditions with one another or with styles such as jazz, pop, or electronic music.
